title: Logical OR of Two Binary Grids Represented as Quad-Trees
goal: Compute logical OR of two compressed binary images and compress the result.
strategy: A true leaf makes its entire region true, while a false leaf contributes nothing and can reuse the other subtree. Only two mixed regions require four recursive comparisons. Equal result leaves collapse back into one leaf.
